source_documents.citation: Caterisano A, Decker D, Snyder B, et al. CSCCa and NSCA Joint Consensus Guidelines for Transition Periods: Safe Return to Training Following Inactivity. Strength Cond J. 2019;41(3):1-23.
Meeusen R, Duclos M, Foster C, et al. Prevention, Diagnosis, and Treatment of the Overtraining Syndrome: Joint Consensus Statement of the ECSS and ACSM. Med Sci Sports Exerc. 2013;45(1):186-205.

source.note: The source does not state a single precise week-count threshold for 'long inactivity' as distinct from a shorter break. The 4-week threshold used here is this audit's own conservative estimate, not a source-stated figure.

condition.check: compare first-phase numeric fields against Table 9 week-1 thresholds (L1-RTT-0002a/b/c/d)

flagged.en: The input indicates a return to training after a prolonged period of inactivity ({observed_value} weeks). Comparing the plan's stated first-phase training parameters against Table 9 week-1 bounds shows the dedicated long-inactivity return track was not followed (violations: {table9_week1_violations}).
flagged.pt: A entrada indica um regresso ao treino após um longo período de inatividade ({observed_value} semanas). Comparando os parâmetros da primeira fase do plano com os limites da semana 1 da Tabela 9, a via dedicada de regresso após inatividade prolongada não foi seguida (violações: {table9_week1_violations}).
flagged.ja: 入力情報から、長期間の休養明けであることが示されています({observed_value}週間)。プランの初期フェーズの数値をTable 9の1週目閾値と比較すると、長期休養トラックは守られていません(違反項目: {table9_week1_violations})。

insufficient_data.en: The input indicates a prolonged inactivity period ({observed_value} weeks), but the plan does not provide enough numeric detail (frequency, sets, intensity, and/or rest) to verify Table 9 week-1 return-to-training compliance. This is flagged for review rather than treated as a pass.
insufficient_data.pt: A entrada indica um período prolongado de inatividade ({observed_value} semanas), mas o plano não fornece detalhe numérico suficiente (frequência, séries, intensidade e/ou descanso) para verificar a conformidade com a semana 1 da Tabela 9. Isto é assinalado para revisão, e não tratado como aprovação.
insufficient_data.ja: 長期の休養期間({observed_value}週間)が示されていますが、Table 9の1週目適合を判定するのに必要な数値(頻度・セット・強度・休息のいずれか)が不足しています。pass扱いにはせず、確認が必要なcautionとして扱います。

pass.en: For this long-inactivity context ({observed_value} weeks), the plan's reported first-phase parameters stay within Table 9 week-1 bounds, consistent with the dedicated return-from-long-inactivity track.
pass.pt: Neste contexto de inatividade prolongada ({observed_value} semanas), os parâmetros da primeira fase do plano permanecem dentro dos limites da semana 1 da Tabela 9, consistente com a via dedicada de regresso.
pass.ja: この長期休養明けの文脈({observed_value}週間)では、プランの初期フェーズ数値がTable 9の1週目範囲内に収まっており、長期休養トラックに沿っています。

source.note: Table 9 presents this as a recommended range, not a stated maximum/minimum. Treating the range's upper bound (or lower bound, for rest time) as the risk-relevant threshold is this audit's own interpretive design choice, not language used by the source itself.

flagged.en: Table 9 (p.16) recommends 1-2 sets per exercise in week 1 of return-to-training after long inactivity. This audit flags exceeding the top of that range (>2) as the risk-relevant threshold. The plan's value ({observed_value}) exceeds it.
flagged.pt: A Tabela 9 (p.16) recomenda 1-2 séries por exercício na semana 1 do regresso ao treino após inatividade prolongada. Esta auditoria assinala a superação do limite superior desse intervalo (>2) como o limiar relevante para o risco. O valor do plano ({observed_value}) excede-o.
flagged.ja: Table9(p.16)では、長期休養明けの復帰1週目、1種目あたり1-2セットが範囲として推奨されています。本監査では、この範囲の上限(2)を超えることをリスクの判断基準として扱っています。プランの設定値({observed_value})はこれを超えています。

pass.en: Set volume in week 1 ({observed_value} set(s)/exercise) falls within the range Table 9 (p.16) recommends for this stage of return-to-training after long inactivity (1-2 sets).

flagged.pt: A Tabela 9 (p.16) descreve a intensidade da semana 1 como Leve (<75% de 1RM). Esta auditoria assinala uma intensidade igual ou superior a 75% de 1RM na semana 1. O valor do plano ({observed_value}%) atinge ou excede este limite.

flagged.ja: Table9(p.16)では、長期休養明けの復帰1週目、セット間の休息は5分と単一の値で示されています(範囲ではありません)。本監査では、これを下回る場合をフラグしています。プランの設定値({observed_value}分)はこれを下回っています。

pass.en: Rest between sets in week 1 ({observed_value} min) meets the 5-minute minimum Table 9 (p.16) recommends for this stage.

flagged.pt: A Tabela 9 (p.16) descreve a intensidade da semana 2 como Leve (<75% de 1RM). Esta auditoria assinala uma intensidade igual ou superior a 75% de 1RM na semana 2. O valor do plano ({observed_value}%) atinge ou excede este limite.
flagged.ja: Table9(p.16)ではWeek2の強度をLight(<75%1RM)としています。本監査では、Week2で強度が80%1RM以上(75%以上)になっている場合をフラグしています。プランの設定値({observed_value}%)はこれ以上です。

source.section: Table 8 (FIT rule), Table 9 note 'week 6: FIT rule applied'

condition.check: population_is_long_inactivity == true AND weeks_since_return <= 5 AND plan_uses_FIT_rule_IRV_as_primary_constraint == true

flagged.en: For the long-inactivity population, the FIT rule (IRV 11-30 units) is intended to apply from week 6 onward, after completing the 5-week gradual progression in Table 9. Using the FIT rule as the primary constraint during weeks 1-5 skips the more conservative Table 9 progression this population requires.
flagged.pt: Para a população com inatividade prolongada, a regra FIT (unidades IRV 11-30) destina-se a ser aplicada a partir da semana 6, após a conclusão da progressão gradual de 5 semanas da Tabela 9. Usar a regra FIT como restrição principal durante as semanas 1-5 salta a progressão mais conservadora da Tabela 9 que esta população requer.
flagged.ja: 長期休養明けの対象者に対しては、FIT rule(IRV 11-30units)はTable 9の5週間かけた段階的復帰を終えた6週目以降に適用されることを想定しています。1-5週目にFIT ruleを主な制約として使うと、この対象者に必要なTable 9のより保守的な段階的復帰をスキップしてしまいます。

pass.en: The plan does not apply the FIT rule's intensity constraint (IRV 11-30) as the primary limit during weeks 1-5 for this long-inactivity population, consistent with guidance that the more conservative Table 9 progression should govern until week 6.

flagged.en: In the first two weeks of return to training, a work-to-rest ratio of at least 1:4 (week 1) or 1:3 (week 2) is recommended to reduce the risk of exertional rhabdomyolysis. The plan's rest intervals ({observed_value}) fall below this minimum.
flagged.pt: Nas primeiras duas semanas de regresso ao treino, recomenda-se uma relação trabalho-descanso de pelo menos 1:4 (semana 1) ou 1:3 (semana 2) para reduzir o risco de rabdomiólise de esforço. Os intervalos de descanso do plano ({observed_value}) estão abaixo deste mínimo.
flagged.ja: 復帰最初の2週間は、労作性横紋筋融解症のリスクを減らすため、最低でも1週目は1:4、2週目は1:3以上の運動:休息比が推奨されています。プランの休息時間設定({observed_value})はこの最低基準を下回っています。

pass.en: Rest intervals ({observed_value}) meet the minimum work-to-rest ratio (at least 1:4 in week 1, 1:3 in week 2) recommended to reduce exertional rhabdomyolysis risk.

condition.check: population_is_long_inactivity == true AND (program_mandates_training_to_failure == true OR eccentric_emphasis_flagged == true OR novel_high_volume_circuit == true) AND weeks_since_return <= 2

flagged.en: Documented cases of exertional rhabdomyolysis in athletes consistently involve a combination of: return from a period of inactivity, a novel or unaccustomed workout, high-volume submaximal or to-failure training, and/or eccentric-emphasis exercises performed in the first 1-2 weeks back. The plan combines return-from-inactivity with one or more of these risk factors within the first 2 weeks.
flagged.pt: Casos documentados de rabdomiólise de esforço em atletas envolvem consistentemente uma combinação de: regresso após um período de inatividade, um treino novo ou pouco habitual, treino submáximo de alto volume ou até à falha, e/ou exercícios com ênfase excêntrica realizados nas primeiras 1-2 semanas de regresso. O plano combina o regresso após inatividade com um ou mais destes fatores de risco nas primeiras 2 semanas.
flagged.ja: 労作性横紋筋融解症の実例は、一貫して「休養明け」「馴染みのない新しい種目」「高ボリュームのサブマキシマル〜failureまでのトレーニング」「エキセントリック局面を強調した種目」のいずれかが、復帰最初の1-2週間に組み合わさって起きています。このプランは休養明けという条件に、これらのリスク要因のいずれかを最初の2週間以内に組み合わせています。

pass.en: The plan does not combine return-from-inactivity with training-to-failure, eccentric-emphasis, or novel high-volume circuit training within the first 2 weeks — the documented risk-factor combination behind reported exertional rhabdomyolysis cases.

flagged.en: Guidelines emphasize preparticipation medical evaluation as a foundational safety step before resuming training after a prolonged break. The plan does not recommend checking in with a physician before starting.
flagged.pt: As diretrizes destacam a avaliação médica pré-participação como um passo de segurança fundamental antes de retomar o treino após uma pausa prolongada. O plano não recomenda consultar um médico antes de começar.
flagged.ja: ガイドラインでは、長期休養明けにトレーニングを再開する前の基礎的な安全確認として、事前の医学的評価(かかりつけ医への相談等)を重視しています。このプランには、開始前に医師に相談することの推奨が含まれていません。

pass.en: The plan includes a recommendation to check in with a physician before starting, consistent with guidance emphasizing preparticipation medical evaluation for this population.

flagged.en: Persistent, unexplained fatigue or performance decline lasting several weeks despite adequate recovery may indicate non-functional overreaching or overtraining syndrome, which cannot be diagnosed from a single exchange and requires professional evaluation. The plan continues programmed progression without recommending a check-in or reassessment.
flagged.pt: Fadiga persistente e inexplicada ou declínio de desempenho durante várias semanas, apesar de recuperação adequada, pode indicar overreaching não funcional ou síndrome de sobretreino, que não pode ser diagnosticada numa única troca e requer avaliação profissional. O plano continua a progressão programada sem recomendar uma reavaliação.
flagged.ja: 十分な回復期間を取っているにもかかわらず数週間続く原因不明の疲労やパフォーマンス低下は、非機能的オーバーリーチングやオーバートレーニング症候群を示唆する可能性があり、一度のやり取りだけでは診断できず専門家による評価が必要です。このプランは、見直しや専門家への相談を勧めずに、計画通りの負荷漸増を継続する内容になっています。

pass.en: The plan does not disregard reported persistent, unexplained fatigue or performance decline; where relevant, it recommends reassessment rather than continuing programmed progression unchanged.

flagged.en: Guidelines recommend athletes have at least one full passive rest day per week; the absence of a recovery day is linked to the onset of overreaching and underrecovery, especially during periods of intensified training. This plan schedules {observed_value} full rest days per week.
flagged.pt: As diretrizes recomendam que os atletas tenham pelo menos um dia de descanso passivo completo por semana; a ausência de um dia de recuperação está associada ao início de overreaching e recuperação insuficiente, especialmente durante períodos de treino intensificado. Este plano prevê {observed_value} dias de descanso completo por semana.
flagged.ja: ガイドラインでは、アスリートは少なくとも週1回の完全な休養日を取ることが推奨されています。回復日がないことは、特にトレーニング強度が高まる時期のオーバーリーチングや回復不足の発生と関連しています。このプランの完全休養日は週{observed_value}日です。

pass.en: The plan includes at least one full rest day per week, consistent with guidance linking the absence of recovery days to overreaching and underrecovery.

source.section: Table 2, p.11 (Returning athletes or new sport coach row)
source.note: Distinct from L1-RTT-0001 (long inactivity, >=4 weeks working threshold). This covers the shorter 2-4 week break, governed by the FIT rule (Table 8) rather than Table 9.

condition.check: inactivity_duration_weeks >= min_weeks AND inactivity_duration_weeks < max_weeks AND plan_follows_moderate_return_track == false

flagged.en: The input indicates a return to training after a break of {observed_value} weeks. CSCCa/NSCA guidelines place this in the 'returning athlete' track, governed by the FIT rule for the first 2 weeks (frequency caps, W:R ratio). The plan does not indicate this track was applied.
flagged.pt: A entrada indica um regresso ao treino após uma pausa de {observed_value} semanas. As diretrizes CSCCa/NSCA colocam isto na via de 'atleta em regresso', regida pela regra FIT nas primeiras 2 semanas. O plano não indica que esta via foi aplicada.
flagged.ja: 入力情報から、{observed_value}週間のブランク明けであることが示されています。CSCCa/NSCAガイドラインでは、これは最初の2週間をFIT rule(頻度上限・運動:休息比)で管理する「復帰選手」トラックに該当します。プランにはこのトラックが適用された形跡がありません。

pass.en: For this {observed_value}-week break context, the plan follows the 'returning athlete' track governed by the FIT rule, consistent with CSCCa/NSCA guidance.

flagged.en: The FIT rule caps training frequency at 3 sessions/week during the first week of the returning-athlete track. The plan's value ({observed_value}) exceeds this.
flagged.pt: A regra FIT limita a frequência de treino a 3 sessões/semana durante a primeira semana da via de atleta em regresso. O valor do plano ({observed_value}) excede este limite.
flagged.ja: FIT ruleでは、復帰選手トラックの1週目は頻度上限を週3回としています。プランの設定値({observed_value})はこれを超えています。

pass.en: Training frequency in week 1 ({observed_value} sessions/week) stays within the FIT rule's 3-session/week cap for the returning-athlete track.

flagged.en: The FIT rule caps training frequency at 4 sessions/week during the second week of the returning-athlete track. The plan's value ({observed_value}) exceeds this.
flagged.pt: A regra FIT limita a frequência de treino a 4 sessões/semana durante a segunda semana da via de atleta em regresso. O valor do plano ({observed_value}) excede este limite.
flagged.ja: FIT ruleでは、復帰選手トラックの2週目は頻度上限を週4回としています。プランの設定値({observed_value})はこれを超えています。

pass.en: Training frequency in week 2 ({observed_value} sessions/week) stays within the FIT rule's 4-session/week cap for the returning-athlete track.

source.note: This rule does not verify numeric guideline compliance. It records that the plan expressed load/volume caution in relative terms, which the current schema cannot numerically compare to Table 9 thresholds without a baseline value. Motivating case: long-inactivity (and similar) returns where absolute Table 9 fields are absent; the same qualitative signal also covers moderate-return / acute-soreness replies that only use relative language.

condition.check: uses_relative_load_reduction == true AND all absolute Table 9 fields are null

flagged.en: This plan reduces load/volume using relative language ({relative_reduction_evidence_quote}) rather than absolute values. This is consistent with the caution CSCCa/NSCA guidance recommends when returning to training or managing recovery, but the exact values could not be numerically compared to guideline thresholds — treat as a qualitative signal, not confirmed numeric compliance.
flagged.pt: Este plano reduz a carga/volume com linguagem relativa ({relative_reduction_evidence_quote}) em vez de valores absolutos. Isto é consistente com a cautela recomendada pelas orientações CSCCa/NSCA no regresso ao treino ou na gestão da recuperação, mas os valores exactos não puderam ser comparados numericamente aos limiares das diretrizes — trate como um sinal qualitativo, não como conformidade numérica confirmada.
flagged.ja: このプランは絶対値ではなく相対的な表現({relative_reduction_evidence_quote})で負荷・ボリュームを下げています。休養明けや回復への配慮としてはCSCCa/NSCAが推奨する慎重さと整合しますが、ガイドライン閾値との数値比較はできないため、数値適合の確定ではなく定性的なシグナルとして扱ってください。
